runtime_encoding_inspection.method: Read ELF entry/load segment and disassemble at entry, direct call targets and materialized addresses inside executable text, stopping each function at ret/syscall. This avoids treating alignment bytes as instructions. Straight-line helpers and main loops here have no earlier returns. Supplied O0 backend, offline inspection after final timing.

records.inspection: One direct step call per live iteration; loop at 0x4000d8, backedge 0x40011e. Main saves rbx and reserves 72 bytes, helper reserves 16. Volatile bound, induction value and sum remain stack-backed.

Main reserves 288 bytes including the 256-byte array. The live update loop at 0x4000fb has a backedge at 0x400189, an indexed load at 0x40013f and store at 0x40016e. No calls in the loop. Initialization and checked reduction loops also remain.

Loop at 0x4000f0, backedge 0x400124, direct helper call at 0x400104. Main reserves 80 bytes; helper reserves 64 plus transient 16-byte slots to transfer its x87 result/constant and XMM ABI values. Floating addition and memory traffic remain live; these are observed stack transfers, not a claim of allocator spill counts.
